title: AutoConfigLab
subtitle: Network Automation Configuration Platform
description: Laravel + Ansible platform for guided Cisco IOS configuration with IP conflict detection, VLAN validation, rollback capabilities, and audit logging.
problem: Manual network device configuration is error-prone and lacks validation. Need automated workflows with pre-deployment checks and rollback capabilities.
approach: Built a wizard-driven platform using Laravel 13 and Ansible that validates configurations before deployment, detects IP conflicts and VLAN duplication, and provides one-click rollback.
results: Working platform with async job execution, deployment history auditing, RBAC enforcement, and a visual topology dashboard for Cisco IOS devices.

title: CyberNest SOAR
subtitle: AI-Enhanced Security Orchestration Platform
description: Open-source SOAR platform integrating SIEM, EDR, and NDR telemetry with automated incident response workflows. Built as a team project with containerized microservices architecture.
problem: SOC teams face alert fatigue from high-volume, low-context alerts across disconnected security tools. Manual triage and response workflows slow down incident handling.
approach: Designed a modular SOAR architecture that orchestrates security tools through a centralized event-driven backend, with automated enrichment and response playbooks.
results: Core SOAR integration milestone completed with working Docker deployment of Wazuh, TheHive, Cortex, Suricata, Zeek, and Velociraptor. Backend API with 140+ endpoints across 25 categories for orchestration and enrichment.

title: AI-Assisted Network Forensics
subtitle: ML-Based Anomaly Detection on Network Traffic
description: Academic project building a machine learning pipeline for detecting C2 communication and data exfiltration in PCAP data.
problem: Signature-based IDS struggles to detect C2 channels hidden in encrypted or low-and-slow traffic. Need anomaly detection approaches for zero-day threats.
approach: Built an ML pipeline using Scikit-learn to analyze PCAP data with custom features based on flow duration, packet entropy, and protocol behavior. Integrated with Zeek and Suricata for multi-layered validation.
results: Anomaly detection pipeline capable of identifying suspicious network patterns. Multi-layered validation approach combining ML classification with traditional IDS signatures.

title: Inventory Vault
subtitle: Secure Asset Management System
description: Laravel 11 inventory management application with CSRF protection, SQL injection prevention via Eloquent ORM, XSS escaping, and Bcrypt password hashing.
problem: Web applications need security built in, not bolted on. Every input must be validated, every session protected, every query parameterized.
approach: Built a full-stack inventory system using Laravel 11 with security-first design: CSRF tokens on all forms, Eloquent ORM for SQL injection prevention, XSS escaping, Bcrypt password hashing, and secure session management.
results: Functional inventory management system with CRUD operations, multi-tagging system, dynamic filtering, and comprehensive security controls against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

title: NeonNet CyberDeck
subtitle: End-to-End Encrypted Messenger
description: Zero-knowledge encrypted messaging system with RSA-4096/AES-256-GCM hybrid encryption, TCP relay server, and a curses-based TUI interface.
problem: Secure communication requires end-to-end encryption where the server never sees plaintext. Need proper cryptographic primitives — not just encryption as a feature, but as the foundation.
approach: Implemented hybrid encryption (RSA-4096 OAEP for key exchange, AES-256-GCM for messages) with RSA-PSS digital signatures. Built a TCP relay server using Python AsyncIO that forwards only ciphertext.
results: Functional encrypted messenger with key exchange, real-time messaging, file transfer (25MB limit), digital signatures, and a curses-based TUI (CyberDeck). Server operates with zero knowledge of plaintext.
